title: Exec pocket brief: roadmap lanes and ops handoff for monthly readout
creator: Asha Patel
description: Purpose: Create a concise, 1-page executive pocket brief and a 6-slide companion for the monthly roadmap readout. The brief must translate product lanes into operational handoff requirements for EngOps and Platform teams (capacity, rollout artifacts, SLO adjustments, and rollbacks). Audience: CEO, Head of Product, CTO, EngOps leads. Outcome: clear decisions and action owners for any runway or resource trade-offs. This ticket coordinates artifacts, reviewers, and the dry-run slot on 2026-03-17. Deliverables: 1) one-page pocket brief (PDF), 2) 6-slide readout deck, 3) decision register with owners and RACI, 4) ops handoff checklist per lane.

6-slide deck with 2-slide risk & mitigation and 1-slide KPIs

Distributed to execs and EngOps 48 hours before readout
